## MCP and app parity

- [ ] Linked the matching app change, or explained why no app change is required.
- [ ] Synced the app-owned bridge contract and ran its drift check.
- [ ] Covered native persistence, explicit targets/time units, actual applied IDs and error paths.
- [ ] Verified connected behavior, not just a successful acknowledgement.
- [ ] Checked one-step undo/redo and that failed mutations leave state/history unchanged.
- [ ] Measured default responses and any explicit pages against their byte budgets.
- [ ] Updated user/contributor docs and examples; distinguished released behavior from development.
- [ ] Recorded any authentication, entitlement, codec or client checks that could not be performed.
